title: Make every page introduction welcoming to first-time readers
description:
As a first-time visitor, I want each page to explain the AI test in everyday language so I can understand why its results matter without reading the homepage first.

Feature: Self-contained page introductions
Scenario: Arrive directly on a category or result page
Given I have never visited this site
When I read the heading and introduction
Then I understand what the AI was asked, what detail changed, and what the page shows
And headings describe the topic without unexplained study terminology
And claims remain faithful to the recorded tests.

Review all category pages, model pages, result templates, and standalone introductions. Preserve measurements and links.
